info.title: ClawdMarket Web Page Metadata
info.description: Platform-run x402 pay-per-call endpoint on clawdmkt.com. One payment (USDC on Solana or Base) buys one fetch of one public web page, returned as JSON metadata.

post.summary: Fetch web page metadata as JSON, $0.01 USDC per call
post.description: Fetch one public web page and return its title, description, canonical URL, language, headings, Open Graph tags, link counts and word count as JSON. Reads at most 2 MB; private and local addresses are refused. Charged only when the fetch succeeds. Send the JSON body without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to receive HTTP 402 with the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2, exact: USDC on Base by EIP-3009, and USDC on Solana when a second accepts entry is offered). Sign one of those requirements and repeat the same request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The payment is settled only after the call succeeds; one authorization buys one call.

200.description: result and payment (charged, amount_units, transaction, receipt_id); PAYMENT-RESPONSE header when settled

400.description: INVALID_INPUT or a malformed payment; nothing charged

402.description: Payment required (requirements in the body and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header), payment rejected, or X402_SETTLEMENT_FAILED

422.description: The call failed (for example FETCH_FAILED or URL_NOT_PUBLIC); nothing charged

503.description: X402_PAY_PER_CALL_DISABLED, X402_UNAVAILABLE or new payments paused; nothing charged
